snippet.title: Master System Longplay [073] Hang-On
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: MrPopsicle43

Incredibly boring and repetitive Rad Racer clone. I dont know why. The lack of music? It doesn't help that the game is pretty long.
All 8 courses shown. After it loops, I just fail so you can see my score.
